Who We Are

A dependable commercial partner for construction.

BOKAN operates under BlackRock Investment PLC, a holding company based in Meskel Flower, Addis Ababa. The business is focused on making construction-material procurement straightforward, dependable and commercially practical.

A concentrated portfolio covering plywood panels, wire products and construction fasteners.

03 • Products

Materials specified for real construction work.

The BOKAN catalog offers eleven standard products across panels, timber, cement, wire products and fasteners, with additional sizes and grades available on request.

Plywood

Four panel solutions.

Formwork and structural panel options selected for demanding site applications.

Plastic FormworkPlastic formwork panel made for concrete shuttering and repeated site use. It is waterproof, durable, recyclable and designed for consistent performance in demanding construction applications.1220 × 2440 mm • 30+ reuse cyclesRequest a Quote
Green Plastic Laminated PlywoodPlastic film laminated plywood designed for moisture resistance, abrasion resistance and concrete-forming applications.1220 × 2440 mm • 18 mm • 6–15 reuse cyclesRequest a Quote
Standard Waterproof PlywoodDurable, high-quality plywood with waterproof moisture resistance for roofing, flooring, wall sheathing, hoarding and other demanding applications.1220 × 2440 mm • 18 mm • BB/CC, B/BB optionsRequest a Quote
MDFVersatile medium-density fiberboard suitable for furniture, cabinetry, interior fit-outs and general woodworking applications.Standard sizes and thicknesses availableRequest a Quote

Wire & Fasteners

Essential site materials.

Complementary products for reinforcement, tying, fencing, carpentry and general construction requirements.

Galvanized Steel Wire

Hot-dip galvanized mild steel wire with corrosion resistance for fencing, rebar tying, mesh, gabions and industrial binding.

1–25 mm diameters • 5, 25, 50 and 100 kg coils.

Request a Quote

Black Annealed Binding Wire

Soft, flexible annealed wire for rebar and mesh tying, baling, bundling and wrapping.

1.5 mm & 2.5 mm • coils or pre-cut lengths.

Request a Quote

Common Nail

Construction nails for timber framing, formwork assembly, roofing, joinery and flooring.

25–150 mm • bright or hot-dip galvanized finish.

Request a Quote
